ov: A brown-furred mustelid with a cream to yellow bib on its throat, found across most of Europe. It is the only mustelid with semi-retractable claws, which help it climb and run through trees. Where it has returned in Britain and Ireland, grey squirrels have retreated and red squirrels recovered.
len: Up to 53 cm, plus a tail of about 25 cm
rg: Most of Europe, Asia Minor, the Caucasus and parts of Iran, Iraq and Syria.
df: Small mammals, birds, insects, frogs and carrion, plus berries, fruit, eggs, nuts and honey.
fx: Grey squirrels spend more time on the ground than red squirrels, which makes them easier prey for pine martens.
Wild pine martens typically live 3–4 years; the oldest recorded in the wild reached 11.
